app.name: OpenMasjid Students
app.tagline: The madrasa office in one app

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to your madrasa's office
auth.setupSubtitle: First-run setup — this account manages everything on the masjid network.
auth.resetRequestSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If that email is registered, we've sent a link to reset your password. Please check your inbox.
auth.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.
auth.adminTunnelNote: Admin sign-in only works on the masjid network. Teachers, finance and parents can sign in from anywhere.
auth.setupOnLanBody: Set up the admin account from a device on the masjid’s own Wi-Fi — for safety, the first admin can’t be created over the internet.
auth.changeSubtitle: Please choose a new password to continue.

home.title: You’re signed in
home.next: Your role’s dashboard arrives in the next steps — attendance, grades, billing and the family portal.

directory.title: Directory
directory.empty: No families yet. Add your first family to get started.
directory.name: Name
directory.feePlanHint: Every student needs a fee plan, so they’re included when invoices are generated.
directory.noFeePlans: Create a fee plan under Billing first.
directory.resetNeedsEmail: Add an email address for this guardian first — use Edit.
directory.guardianEditHint: Guardians belong to the family, so this updates them everywhere. Clearing a field removes it.
directory.mailSent: Emailed — the link below is the same one, in case they don’t get it.
directory.mailNoUrl: Not emailed: this app has no public web address yet, so the link would only work on the masjid network. Turn on Remote access for OpenMasjid Students in OpenMasjidOS, or share the link below directly.
directory.mailNoTransport: Not emailed: no email is set up yet. Add SMTP under Settings, or set up email in OpenMasjidOS — or just share the link below.
directory.mailNotSent: Couldn’t send the email. Share the link below instead.
directory.pinHint: A 6-digit PIN is created automatically — parents use the child’s name + PIN to pay.
directory.inviteHint: Creates a one-time sign-up link (valid 7 days) — copy it to the guardian. They need an email on file.

students.title: Students
students.empty: No students yet — add a family, then add students to it, or import a CSV.
students.name: Name
students.addViaFamily: Students are added inside a family record, so siblings share one bill.

import.title: Import students
import.intro: Upload a CSV and match its columns to the fields below. Nothing is saved until you review the result.
import.emptyFile: That file has no rows we could read.
import.matchHint: {{file}} — {{rows}} rows. We guessed these; change anything that looks wrong.
import.idsGenerated: Student IDs and PINs are always generated here — they can’t be imported from a file.
import.defaultPlanHint: Used for any row without a Fee plan column. Every student needs a plan, or the row is rejected.
import.fixFirst: Fix these rows in the CSV and upload it again — nothing is imported while any row has a problem.
import.pinsOnce: These PINs are shown once. Print or copy them now — you can always regenerate a PIN later from the student record.

year.title: Year view
year.noYear: No school year yet. Set one up under Structure, then invoices and this grid line up to it.
year.needsStartYear: “{{label}}” has no starting calendar year, so its months can’t be worked out. Add one under Structure → School years.
year.pinWarning: PIN is off by default. Switching it on puts every child’s payment PIN on this page and on anything you print from it.
year.legend: ✓ paid · ½ part-paid · · not paid yet · — voided · blank means no invoice for that month. A month is the family’s bill, so siblings share it.

structure.title: Structure
structure.yearsHint: The billing calendar. A madrasa year usually runs across two calendar years — April to March, say — and the months you set here become the columns on the year view and the periods invoices are generated for.
structure.wrapHint: A year that ends before it starts runs into the next calendar year — April to March is twelve months.
structure.termsHint: Only needed if you charge tuition per term. A fee plan set to “per term” is billed on term periods; monthly plans ignore terms entirely.
structure.termsNeedYear: Add a school year first — terms belong to one.
structure.noTerms: No terms — this year is billed by month.
structure.coursesHint: How the roster is grouped. A course holds classes; a student sits in one class. This is for organising and billing only — no teachers, attendance or grades. Until a class exists, every student shows as unplaced.
structure.noCourses: No courses yet. Add one, then add its classes — the Students tab groups by these.
structure.courseArchived: Archived “{{name}}” and its classes. Students in them are now unplaced.

mass.title: Mass apply
mass.feeHint: Puts a fee plan on every student you pick. Safe to run twice — a student who already has the plan is skipped, never charged twice.
mass.chargeHint: Adds a one-off line for every student you pick. This is NOT repeat-safe: applying it twice bills twice.
mass.periodHint: Leave “Bill in” empty to put the charge on the next invoice generated for each family; set it to a month like 2026-07 to attach it to that month.
mass.negativeHint: A negative amount is a credit — use it to refund or discount a student without touching an invoice already raised.
mass.noStructure: No courses or classes yet — set them up under Structure, or pick students directly.
mass.feeResult: Assigned to {{assigned}} of {{targeted}}. {{skipped}} already had it.
mass.chargeResult: Charged {{created}} of {{targeted}}. {{attached}} went onto an invoice that was already open; the rest wait for the next generation.
mass.confirmCharge: Charge {{count}} students? This adds a new line each time it runs.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.manualHint: Add each weekly session — you’ll be warned (never blocked) if a teacher or room is double-booked.
schedule.warnTeacher: {{teacher}} is also teaching {{class}} at this time.
schedule.warnRoom: {{room}} is also booked for {{class}} at this time.
schedule.pickToView: Pick one to see its week.

teach.weekIntro: Here’s your teaching week. Open a class to see its roster and subjects.
teach.noSessions: You have no scheduled sessions yet. The office sets the timetable.
teach.noClasses: You’re not assigned to any classes yet.
teach.classDenied: This class isn’t assigned to you.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.pastDate: Editing a past day — this change is recorded.
attendance.discardUnsaved: You have unsaved attendance for this day. Switch date and discard it?

gradebook.title: Gradebook
gradebook.noItems: No assignments yet. Add one to start grading.
gradebook.overMax: That score is above the maximum of {{max}}.
gradebook.saveFailed: That score couldn’t be saved. Please try again.
gradebook.confirmDelete: Delete “{{title}}” and all its scores? This can’t be undone.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.hint: The transcript is the student's cumulative record across all closed terms. Regenerating keeps old versions; publish makes the latest visible to parents (portal coming soon).

exams.title: Exams
exams.noExams: No exams in this term yet.
exams.noTerms: Add a term (in Classes) before creating exams.
exams.noClasses: No classes in this term yet.
exams.noSubjects: This class has no subjects to grade.
exams.confirmUnassign: Remove this exam from the class? Any marks entered for it will be deleted.
exams.noneAssigned: No exams assigned to this class yet. The office sets these up.
exams.cellHint: Type a mark, or “a” for absent, “e” for exempt. Leave blank if not yet marked.
exams.overMax: That mark is above the maximum of {{max}}.
exams.saveFailed: That mark couldn’t be saved. Please try again.
exams.remarkPlaceholder: Optional remark for this student’s report card

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeBody: Manage your madrasa — families, students, classes and records. Pick a section below.

classes.setCurrentHint: Double-click to make this the current term
classes.noTerms: Add a term to start creating classes.
classes.noClasses: No classes in this term yet.
classes.subjectsHint: Comma-separated, e.g. Sabaq, Sabqī, Manzil, Tajwīd
classes.confirmClose: Close this term? Each student's final grade will be frozen from the current exam marks. You can reopen to make changes.
classes.closedNote: This term is closed — final grades are frozen. Reopen to make changes.

staff.title: Staff
staff.name: Name
staff.tempHint: At least 12 characters — changed on first sign-in
staff.formHint: Enter a username and a temporary password of at least 12 characters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reachHint: Invites, password resets and receipts all depend on these. If one is missing, the office can still share links by hand — but nothing will be emailed.
settings.reachUrlFrom_env: From the address set when this app was installed.
settings.reachUrlFix: Parents can’t open a link that only works on the masjid network. In OpenMasjidOS, go to Settings → Remote access and turn on sharing for OpenMasjid Students.
settings.reachMailSmtp: Using this app’s own SMTP settings.
settings.reachMailPlatform: Using the masjid’s OpenMasjidOS email — no SMTP needed here.
settings.reachMailFix: Add SMTP below, or set up email in OpenMasjidOS and this app will use it.
settings.reachSelfRegBlocked: The setting is on, but sign-up needs both an email set-up and a public web address, because the confirmation link is emailed.
settings.schoolHint: Shown on report cards and statements.
settings.smtpHint: Optional but recommended. With email set up, parent invites, payment receipts, and autopay notices are sent automatically. Without it, invites become copy/print links. Your password is stored securely and never shown again.
settings.smtpTestOk: Test email sent — check the inbox.
settings.paymentsHint: Choose which of your OpenMasjidOS Stripe accounts tuition is collected into. This is used for card payments in the parent portal and for the tuition option on your donation site and kiosk.
settings.externalPayments: Accept tuition at your donation site & kiosk
settings.externalPaymentsHint: When on, families can pay their balance with their child's name and PIN on your masjid's donation site and kiosk. Turn it off to hide tuition there — the parent portal is unaffected.
settings.paymentsNoAccounts: No Stripe accounts found. Add one in OpenMasjidOS (Settings → Payments), then reopen this page.
settings.paymentsNotReady: Card payments aren't ready yet — pick an account above (and make sure it's fully set up in OpenMasjidOS).
settings.meritOnReportCard: Show merit points on report cards
settings.selfRegistration: Let parents sign themselves up (with their child’s name + PIN + an on-file email)
settings.selfRegistrationHint: Needs email set up. Turn off to require an office invite instead.
settings.customFieldsHint: Define fields once — they apply to every student’s record (e.g. previous madrasa, juz at intake, walī name).
settings.meritCategoriesHint: Categories teachers award points against, each with a default value (editable per award).
settings.commentBankHint: Reusable remark snippets all teachers can insert into term remarks and report cards.
settings.snippetHint: e.g. Mashā’Allāh, excellent progress this term.

student.noFields: No custom fields defined. Add them in Settings.

billing.label: Label
billing.confirmReverse: Reverse this payment? A reversal entry will be added.
billing.generateHint: Creates one invoice per family (from assigned fees) for this period. Re-running the same period changes nothing.
billing.reconcileHint: Check Stripe for any card payments that didn't come through automatically — from the donation site, the kiosk, or the parent portal — and record the ones that are missing. This runs on its own each day; use it if a payment seems to be missing.
billing.reconcileDone: Checked {{scanned}} payment(s) — recorded {{recorded}} that were missing.
billing.reconcileUnavailable: Card payments aren't set up yet, so there's nothing to sync.
billing.overrideHint: Charges this student a different amount for the same plan — no need to create another plan. Leave the amount empty to put them back on the plan’s price.
billing.itemsHint: A short list of the things you charge for besides tuition — a uniform, an exam fee, a trip. Applying one copies its name and price onto the charge, so re-pricing an item here never changes a charge already raised.
billing.noItems: No items yet. You can still add a one-off charge without one.
billing.itemEditHint: Changes the price for charges added from now on. Charges already raised keep the amount they were given.
billing.chargeHint: Lands on this period’s open invoice straight away if there is one; otherwise it waits for the next generation. A negative amount is a credit. Once it’s on an invoice it can’t be voided — add a negative charge instead.

family.title: Parent Portal
family.subtitle: Your children, balance, and payments
family.noFamily: Your account isn’t linked to a family yet. Please contact the office.
family.acceptGreeting: Welcome, {{name}}. Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
family.inviteInvalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Please ask the office for a new one.
family.registerUnavailable: Self sign-up isn’t available yet. Please ask the office for a portal invite link.
family.registerSubtitle: Enter your child’s name and PIN, plus an email the school has on file for you. We’ll email you a link to set up your account.
family.registerEmailHint: Must be an email the office already has for your family.
family.registerSent: If those details match our records, we’ve emailed you a link to set up your account. Please check your inbox.
family.loadError: We couldn’t load your family right now. Please try again in a moment.
family.payError: That payment couldn’t be completed. Please try again.
family.paidOptimistic: Payment received — it’ll show on your account in a moment. Thank you.
family.autopayOn: On — we’ll charge your default card when tuition is due.
family.autopayConsent: When on, your default card is charged automatically when tuition comes due. Turn it off any time.

admissions.invoiceNeedsFee: Pick a fee plan and fill in the invoice details.
admissions.enrolledInvoicePending: Enrolled — the student’s PIN is {{pin}}. The first invoice couldn’t be generated; create it in Billing.

apply.title: Admission enquiry
apply.subtitle: Tell us about your child — the office will be in touch.
apply.error: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
apply.thanksBody: We’ve received your enquiry. The office will be in touch soon, in shā’ Allāh.
